style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE Slay the Spire 2 Power/status icon, transparent PNG, square. The supplied sheet is ONLY a style reference of actual shipped game icons; generate ONLY the requested new icon, no sheet, no labels. Match the sheet's strength, dexterity, accuracy and ritual: simple cartoon game pictogram, a VERY large bold compact silhouette filling ~86% of square, strong charcoal-black outline about 3.5% canvas width, handmade slightly irregular contour, flat saturated color, ONE large crisp shadow/highlight facet. Keep only 1 main motif. Extremely legible at 32px. Not app icon art: no badge, frame, rounded square, circular backdrop, pastel UI palette, photorealism, texture, gradient, 3D lighting, bloom, glow, noise, tiny lines, text, letters, numerals or watermark. Transparent exterior and interior holes. Center with equal clear margin. Approx 1024px canvas. Requested subject:
